title: Agent Architecture Expansion
brief: Build full agent definition system with model routing, worktree isolation, background execution, and specialization. Currently only 3 project agents. Create user-level agents directory with 8+ specialized agents using all frontmatter fields (model, permissionMode, maxTurns, skills, mcpServers, memory, background, isolation).

phases.title: Agent Definitions + Configuration
phases.description: Create 8 specialized agent definitions with model routing, worktree isolation, background execution, and skills preloading.

units.title: Create ~/.claude/agents/ directory with README
units.rationale: Foundation for all agent definitions. Directory must exist with proper structure and a README explaining the agent system.
exit_conditions: ~/.claude/agents/ directory exists
README.md explains agent frontmatter fields
Example agent template included

steps.instruction: Create ~/.claude/agents/ directory
Create README.md with agent frontmatter field documentation
Include template showing all available fields: model, permissionMode, maxTurns, skills, mcpServers, memory, background, isolation, allowedTools

deliverables.description: Agent system documentation with frontmatter field reference and template

units.description: Create ~/.claude/agents/ directory with README — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: physics-reviewer agent
units.rationale: Physics engines contain critical formulas (Kienzle, Taylor, Johnson-Cook). A dedicated Opus reviewer agent with worktree isolation ensures formula integrity without risking main branch.
exit_conditions: Agent definition works with /agent physics-reviewer
Opus model used for deep reasoning
Worktree isolation prevents accidental main branch edits

steps.instruction: Create physics-reviewer.md with frontmatter: model=opus, isolation=worktree, maxTurns=30, allowedTools=[Read,Grep,Glob,Bash]
Write system prompt: verify physics formulas, check dimensional consistency, cross-reference constants.ts
Include checklist: Kienzle kc structure, Taylor life exponents, Johnson-Cook parameters, unit conversions
Test agent invocation with a sample engine file

deliverables.description: Opus-powered physics formula reviewer with worktree isolation

units.description: physics-reviewer agent — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: test-runner agent
units.rationale: Test execution is I/O-bound and benefits from background execution. Haiku model is sufficient for running tests and parsing results.
exit_conditions: Agent runs tests in background without blocking main conversation
Haiku model parses test output efficiently
Reports failures with file/line context

steps.instruction: Create test-runner.md with frontmatter: model=haiku, background=true, allowedTools=[Bash,Read]
Write system prompt: run targeted tests, parse output, report failures concisely
Include test discovery logic: find tests for given engine/module
Test agent with a specific test file run

units.title: catalog-enricher agent
units.rationale: Catalog enrichment (tool specs, machine profiles) is repetitive and well-scoped. Sonnet handles the pattern matching and data extraction efficiently.
exit_conditions: Agent enriches catalogs using tool-enrich skill
Sonnet model for cost-effective data processing
MCP server connection for PRISM data access

steps.instruction: Create catalog-enricher.md with frontmatter: model=sonnet, skills=[tool-enrich], mcpServers=[prism]
Write system prompt: enrich tool/machine/material catalogs with missing dimensions, speeds, specifications
Include enrichment workflow: read catalog → identify gaps → research → fill → validate
Test agent with a catalog file containing known gaps

units.title: code-archaeologist agent
units.rationale: Deep codebase exploration (tracing dependencies, understanding architecture, finding patterns) needs high turn count and read-only safety. Plan mode prevents accidental edits.
exit_conditions: Agent performs deep read-only exploration with 50 turn limit
Plan permission mode prevents any writes
Reports findings in structured format

steps.instruction: Create code-archaeologist.md with frontmatter: model=sonnet, permissionMode=plan, maxTurns=50
Write system prompt: trace code paths, map dependencies, identify patterns, never modify files
Include output format: structured report with file paths, call chains, findings
Test agent with architecture exploration task

deliverables.description: Sonnet-powered read-only code exploration agent with plan mode

units.description: code-archaeologist agent — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

exit_conditions: Agent wires engines to dispatchers following established patterns
Sonnet model for pattern-following efficiency
forge-wiring skill preloaded for wiring conventions

Write system prompt: wire engines to dispatchers, add z.enum entries, create schema, add handler cases
Include wiring checklist: export from index.ts, z.enum entry, schema definition, handler case, test
Test agent with an unwired engine

units.title: regression-hunter agent
units.rationale: Test failure investigation requires deep reasoning — tracing through multiple files, understanding expected vs actual behavior, identifying root causes. Opus excels at this.
exit_conditions: Agent investigates test failures with deep reasoning
Opus model for complex multi-file analysis
40 turn limit for thorough investigation

steps.instruction: Create regression-hunter.md with frontmatter: model=opus, maxTurns=40, allowedTools=[Read,Grep,Glob,Bash]
Write system prompt: investigate test failures, trace root cause, suggest fix, verify fix doesn't introduce new regressions
Include investigation methodology: reproduce → isolate → trace → diagnose → suggest
Test agent with a known test failure
